messages:
Rae (Design): quick thread — small UX pass on the batch vectors toolbar + export presets. dropped updated frames: https://figma.com/file/clarify-export
Theo (Frontend): thanks. what's the must-fix list for dev?
Rae (Design): three blocks: 1) toolbar 'select' UX ambiguous on mobile (treats selection as page-only). 2) preset dropdown clips under the header on narrow windows. 3) export confirmation doesn't clarify file encoding/line-delimiting.
Kai (A11y): accessibility: announce total selection via aria-live ("4 rows selected"). selection must persist across pagination and refresh. preset dropdown should be accessible via keyboard and have aria-expanded.
Amal (PM): product stance: default download = .jsonl (newline-delimited embeddings) with explicit CTA text. CSV export must open immediate mapping inline, not a separate hidden step. For CSV show a one-line example row and encoding note: "UTF-8, comma-separated".
Luis (Backend): backend ok with ids array + mapping. we can provide export-estimate endpoint to compute approx size; if >5000 rows we'll offer background export with email. we'll also store user presets.
Theo (Frontend): implementation plan: 1) convert toolbar select to global selection store and surface count in header even across pages; 2) move preset dropdown into header overflow so it won't clip; 3) export modal includes format line "Format: JSONL (newline-delimited)".
Rae (Design): copy suggestions: primary CTA -> "Download selected vectors (.jsonl)" secondary -> "Export CSV — map columns" tertiary -> "Save mapping as preset". small helper: "CSV example: title,embedding,source".
Kai (A11y): add focus-return behavior: when modal closes, focus -> toolbar download button. ensure dialog uses role=dialog, aria-modal=true and focus trap. truncated cells need focusable reveal and a copy icon (aria-label="Copy full text").
Theo (Frontend): tiny code for export payload:
```
POST /exports
{ "format":"jsonl", "ids":["v1","v2"], "fields":["id","embedding","meta.title"] }
```
Amal (PM): UX decision: persist last-used CSV mapping per-user and show "Apply recent mapping" in modal. if mapping exists and user selects >10k rows, warn: "Large export will be processed in background. We'll email you when ready."
Rae (Design): visual nit: relevance-pill at 11px fails contrast. prefer a darker tint or white text on saturated chip. also increase tappable area for row actions on touch.
NotifyBot: staging deploy:design-preview succeeded with layout tweak. :tada:
Rae (Design): next steps: Theo to implement selection store + preset placement; Luis to add estimate API & presets; Kai to write a brief a11y checklist for PRs; Amal to finalize CTA copy. target PRs by Friday EOD. :thumbsup:
